description: Item 1: the status-bar text overlaps itself at 800x600 (confirmed reviewer finding, visible in build/standalone-validation/ui-artifacts/2026-10-16-m01-l3-002-docking/narrow/workspace.png: the right-aligned dock summary label runs left over the message label). Reproduce with the real audit, add a regression test that FAILS first, then fix minimally in ui/chrome.rs::status_bar_ui by eliding both labels to their allotted width (message has priority, full text on hover), without touching the region plan. Re-capture 1600x1000 and 800x600 into a new dated folder and view them. Independent of FEAT-002/003 but FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: cargo build -p om9-app in h:\OpenMatrix9\standalone. Run standalone\target\debug\om9.exe --ui-audit <dir> with OM9_UI_AUDIT_WINDOW=800x600 and OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK=1 into build\standalone-validation\ui-artifacts\<Get-Date yyyy-MM-dd>-m01-l3-002-closeout\before-narrow ; open workspace.png and note that the overlap is visible.

In standalone/crates/om9-app/src/ui.rs add `pub status_message_rect: Option<Rect>` and `pub status_summary_rect: Option<Rect>` next to `status_rect` (struct field, initialise None in from_controller). In ui/chrome.rs::status_bar_ui record the label responses' rects into them (reset to None at the start of each status panel frame). Add status_message_px, status_summary_px and status_text_overlap to the receipt `regions` block in audit_receipt. No behaviour change yet.

Create standalone/crates/om9-app/tests/status_bar_overlap.rs with the frame helpers from tests/workbench_regions.rs. Cases: 800x600 + Layers docked right; 720x480 + right dock; 1600x1000 control; 560x300 with a long Error status via app.status.error(...). Assert message.max.x <= summary.min.x + 0.5, both inside status_rect, Dismiss not overlapped when a failure is shown, and that the full text is still reachable (hover text / stored string / CMD history).

RED: cargo test -p om9-app --test status_bar_overlap must exit non-zero with assertion failures (not build errors) on the 800x600 and 720x480 cases. Save command, stdout, stderr and exit code to implementation/evidence/M01/OM9-L3-01-01-002/closeout-01.red.log. If it passes before the fix, repair the test first.

Fix minimally in chrome.rs::status_bar_ui: render message and summary with egui::Label::new(text).truncate(), message laid out first and keeping its width, right group (Dismiss + summary) limited to the remaining width (use ui.allocate_ui_with_layout with an explicit max rect if the nested right_to_left layout still overflows), .on_hover_text(full text) on both. Do not change workbench_regions.rs, dock_layout.rs, StatusSurface semantics or the status text content.
GREEN: cargo test -p om9-app --test status_bar_overlap passes; then cargo test -p om9-app (includes workbench_regions lib/integration and shell_docking). Save to closeout-01.green.log.

Re-capture with the real app into build\standalone-validation\ui-artifacts\<date>-m01-l3-002-closeout\normal (1600x1000, OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK=1) and \narrow (800x600, OM9_UI_AUDIT_RIGHT_DOCK=1). Open both workspace.png files with the image reader and write what is seen (message readable, summary elided, no overlapping glyphs; 1600x1000 shows the full summary). Check receipts: exit 0, 21 passes, status_text_overlap false, region_error null, narrow plan still has RightDockYielded/NarrowWindow and 4 views.
Append a short 'closeout item 1' note (before/after, files, tests, image paths, 'L3-007 sibling scope untouched, region-plan behaviour unchanged') to .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/verification.md.
acceptance_criteria: Before the fix `cargo test -p om9-app --test status_bar_overlap` fails with assertion errors; after the fix it passes (both logs saved).
In the new 800x600 and 1600x1000 screenshots (viewed) the bottom status line shows no overlapping text; receipt status_text_overlap is false.
Existing tests still pass: workbench_regions lib (21) and integration (8), shell_docking (10), whole om9-app.
Only chrome.rs, ui.rs (new rect fields and receipt) and the new test file changed; workbench_regions.rs and dock_layout.rs are unchanged by this feature.
No commit, no staging, no private-tree edits.
verification: cd h:\OpenMatrix9\standalone ; cargo test -p om9-app --test status_bar_overlap
cd h:\OpenMatrix9\standalone ; cargo fmt --all -- --check ; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
om9.exe --ui-audit at 1600x1000 and 800x600 exits 0; images viewed
findings: Done, uncommitted. New pub fields on MatrixApp (ui.rs): status_message_rect, status_summary_rect, status_dismiss_rect (Option<Rect>; reset each status-panel frame, filled by chrome.rs::status_bar_ui). Receipt regions block now has status_message_px, status_summary_px, status_text_overlap (bool; false when a rect is missing). Test file: standalone/crates/om9-app/tests/status_bar_overlap.rs (4 tests; helpers frame_size/startup/settle/assert_status_line_clean/assert_full_text_reachable can be copied by FEAT-002). RED: implementation/evidence/M01/OM9-L3-01-01-002/closeout-01.red.log (exit 101, 3 assertion failures). GREEN: closeout-01.green.log (status_bar_overlap 4/4; cargo test -j 1 -p om9-app exit 0: lib 61, workbench_regions 8, shell_docking 10). NOTE: plain parallel cargo test -p om9-app hit os error 1455 (paging file) while linking; use -j 1 or -j 2 for full runs. Screenshots (viewed, no overlap): build/standalone-validation/ui-artifacts/2026-10-16-m01-l3-002-closeout/{before-narrow,narrow,normal}/ (workspace.png + ui-receipt.json; real audit exit 0, passes=21, status_text_overlap false, region error null, narrow plan RightDockYielded/NarrowWindow, 4 views). Audit run note: om9.exe --ui-audit prints nothing; files appear shortly after exit, so wait before reading receipts. Fix design: Dismiss placed first at right edge, message gets width up to (dismiss.min.x - spacing - 48px reserve), summary gets remainder; both truncate() + on_hover_text(full). Files changed: ui.rs, ui/chrome.rs, tests/status_bar_overlap.rs only (cargo fmt/clippy -D warnings clean). verification.md has the closeout item 1 note. Still for FEAT-003: ledger/progress.json and validation doc note for item 8 (L3-007 sibling, region plan unchanged). Nothing committed or staged.
